seo.description_paragraph: The name Bohun is rooted in Slavic mythology and is derived from the Old Slavic word ‘bogu’, meaning ‘god’, and ‘un’, meaning ‘protector’. The name Bohun is popular among Christians due to its religious connotations and the idea of a powerful protector. Today, Bohun is a unique and meaningful name for a baby boy.
